summary: Tested the new Client-detail tabs (Applications, Database, Subscription, Security), seat-limit enforcement, the App-detail tabs (Deployments, Versions, API, Server, Database, Logs) and session revocation, on both backend and frontend. Backend: 12 of 13 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_client_app_tabs.py. The one failure is a real bug: re-creating a soft-deleted user bypasses the seat limit. Frontend: every requested flow works in the UI. Applications toggle persists after reload and the app's Clients tab reflects it. Database tab shows stats, collections and doc counts. Subscription: picking a plan pre-fills the seat limit (Starter gives 25), and with limit 2 of 2 the 'Seat limit reached' warning shows. As tenant admin, creating a user on the Team page returns 403 and the error modal shows 'Seat limit reached: 2 of 2 users on the Trial plan...'. Security: a wrong password adds a Failed row and a strike, and Unlock clears it. Sign out all users ends the admin's browser session (redirects to /login) and re-login works right away. Deploy 2.5.0 success to production updates the header version. Versions: add with the current tag, duplicate gives 409, delete works. API key: shown once, whoami 200 then 401 after revoke, key_hash never exposed. Server link/unlink works and the no-agent hint shows. App Database lists ZELIX. Logs show deploy/version/key events and refresh works. Regression: the Overview, Users, Product Tour, Activity and Tickets tabs load. Tenant admin /students, /users and /clients load.

critical.issue: Seat limit bypass. (1) If the email belongs to a soft-deleted user, POST /api/users reactivates the row. That path returns before enforce_seat_limit() (users.py ~line 334), so it is never checked. Reproduced: with seat_limit = seats_used, re-creating a deleted TEST_ email returned 201. (2) Reactivation sets deleted_at: None, but seat_usage counts {deleted_at: {$exists: false}}. Reactivated users are never counted as seats, while _active_filter() uses {$in: [None, '']}. POST /api/users/{id}/reactivate likely has the same gap.

minor.issue: seat_limit null/empty falls back to plan.limits.users, so the owner can't set 'Unlimited' on a plan that has a user limit. The UI placeholder says 'Unlimited'.
The revocation check is iat(int) < int(revoked). A token issued earlier in the same second as the revoke survives. Small edge case. Compare against the float, or store the revoke time ceil'd.

A revoked Bearer token falls back to the cookie token. If a browser holds a valid cookie for another identity (e.g. the owner), /api/auth/me returns 200 as that identity. This was a test artefact here, but the user can silently switch. Fine for most cases; just noting it.

issues: Plan options and the Price row show '$999/mo' and '$2999/mo', but the plans have currency INR. Use plan.currency (₹)

design_issues.screen: App detail > Versions / Client Security / API
issues: Release date: new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') is parsed as UTC midnight, so it shows as the previous day for users in negative-offset timezones
Version delete, key revoke and 'Sign out all users' use window.confirm instead of shadcn AlertDialog
The user is bounced to /login with no explanation. Consider showing the 401 detail ('Your session was ended by the administrator')

action_items: HIGH: In routers/users.py create_user, call enforce_seat_limit() before the soft-deleted reactivation branch as well. Do the same in POST /api/users/{id}/reactivate
HIGH: Make lib/subscription.seat_usage use the same active filter as the rest of the app ({deleted_at: {$in: [None, '']}}) so reactivated users count as seats
Optional: allow 'unlimited' seats explicitly (e.g. seat_limit 0 or a flag) instead of always falling back to plan.limits.users
Optional: show the plan currency instead of a hard-coded $; parse version-date as a local date
critical_code_review_comments: tenant_security builds the list of every tenant user email ($in over all users) on each load. Fine now, but it doesn't scale. login_attempts is keyed by email only (not tenant), so a strike on the same email in another tenant also shows here
tenant_database_info runs estimated_document_count per collection in sequence. Fine for about 20 collections
_revoked_cache is per-process with a 10s TTL. With uvicorn workers=1 that's fine. With more than one worker, a revoke takes up to 10s to apply on the other workers
PATCH /apps unlinking stores server_id '' instead of removing it. Harmless
Added data-testid='app-settings-version' to the Version input in the App Settings tab (it was missing)
seed_data_creation: None kept. Restored and cleaned up: seat_limit 50 (Trial, status trial, notes empty); app version 1.0.0; app assigned to ZELIX; server unlinked (server_id ''); hard-deleted the soft-deleted TEST_seat_*/TEST_react_* user rows from test_database_t_8286d28c6b04042a (2 users remain); deleted the TEST deployments and TEST API keys; test versions deleted via the API; login_attempts for admin cleared. Sessions for ZELIX were revoked several times, so old tenant tokens are invalid.
